def safe_note_path(name: str) -> str | None:
    """Relative path inside notes for `name`, or None when `name` is empty, absolute, or would resolve outside notes."""
    pre name.byte_len() <= 4096
    ex safe_note_path("a.txt") == "notes/a.txt"
    ex safe_note_path("../secret.txt") is None
    ex safe_note_path("/etc/passwd") is None
    if name == "" or name.startswith("/") or "\\" in name:
        return None
    for part in name.split("/"):
        if part == "..":
            return None
    return "notes/" + name

def read_note(name: str) -> str uses fs:
    """Text of the file `name` inside the directory notes. Returns "" when the file is missing or unreadable, or when `name` would resolve outside notes."""
    pre name.byte_len() <= 4096
    post name.byte_len() > 0 or out == ""
    path = safe_note_path(name)
    if path is None:
        return ""
    text = fs.read_text(path) else ""
    return text
